messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Subject: Compact evening sprint: technical demo + breakout labs — proposed times & reschedule policy

Hi Emma and Aaron,

Thanks for your interest in a hands-on demo of Redwood Inference. We'd like to run a compact evening "sprint" session that combines a 25–30 minute product walkthrough, a 20–25 minute live configuration + quantization lab (split into breakout rooms), and a 25–30 minute Q&A and next-steps slot. The intention is to give engineers a quick but actionable set of changes they can try the next day.

Proposed options (PT):
- Wed Jul 30 — 6:30pm–8:00pm PT (preferred, single session)
- Thu Jul 31 — 11:00am–12:00pm PT (alternate shorter AM slot)

If neither works, we can split into two shorter sessions the same week. We also have an explicit reschedule policy for multi-company sessions: if a core attendee requests a move >24 hours before the session, we’ll accommodate and publish a final slot 24 hours after the request; last-minute moves (<24 hours) will be handled case-by-case.

Attached: demo-agenda.pdf (high level agenda + prep checklist). RSVP here: https://forms.gle/RSVP-compact-sprint

If you prefer a customer-only workshop vs. a multi-prospect demo, tell me and we’ll carve out a dedicated slot.

Best,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

Hi Emma — happy to flex. Two suggestions that usually help with mixed-company sessions:

1) Move to Thu Jul 31, 11:00–12:00 PT and compress the walkthrough to 20 minutes; breakout labs become two 15-minute micro-labs (teams rotate). This keeps total time to 1 hour.
2) If several teams prefer evening windows, we can keep the Wed evening but run two 45-min sessions (6:30–7:15 / 7:30–8:15) and limit each session to one external company + a neutral demo.

For the lab pre-reqs: minimal network egress is needed — you can either provide temporary AWS STS role (recommended) or open an outbound port for our short-lived agent. I’m attaching a placeholder calendar invite that includes the bridge details and a short runbook.

Attachment: bridge-invite.ics

Attendees locked: Acme Analytics (Emma Rios), BluePeak Inc. (Aaron Lee).
